title: Storage bin
summary: A tough, stackable, Gridfinity-compatible bin with optional dividers, label shelf, scoop and magnet or screw holes.

groups.title: Size
groups.help: Bins are measured in grid units. One unit is 42 mm wide and deep; height is counted in 7 mm units (a 3-unit bin is 21 mm tall plus the stacking lip).

groups.title: Strength
groups.help: Thicker walls and floors make the bin stiffer and harder to crack, at the cost of a little interior space and filament.

groups.title: Stacking
groups.help: The stacking lip lets another bin sit on top of this one exactly as it sits in a baseplate.

groups.title: Compartments
groups.help: Split the bin into equal compartments and add a label shelf or a finger scoop.

groups.title: Base
groups.help: Holes under each foot for magnets (to hold the bin on a steel or magnetic baseplate) or screws (to fix it in place).

params.label: Width
params.help: Width along the front, in 42 mm grid units.

params.label: Depth
params.help: Depth front to back, in 42 mm grid units.

params.label: Height
params.help: Height in 7 mm units, measured to the top of the wall. The stacking lip adds about 4 mm.

params.label: Wall thickness
params.help: 1.2 mm is light and roomy, 1.6 mm is the tough default, 2.0 mm and up is for heavy tools and rough handling. Use a multiple of your line width (e.g. 1.6 = 4 x 0.4 mm).

params.label: Floor height
params.help: Height of the inside floor above the table. The solid floor is this minus 4.75 mm (the feet). 7 mm gives a 2.25 mm floor.

params.label: Stacking lip
params.help: Keep it on to stack bins. Turn it off for a flat-topped bin that fits under a low drawer or shelf.

params.label: Lip top flat
params.help: Blunts the sharp top edge of the lip so it doesn't chip. Stacking still works across the whole range.

params.label: Dividers across
params.help: Number of walls running front to back, splitting the width into equal compartments.

params.label: Dividers front-back
params.help: Number of walls running side to side, splitting the depth into equal compartments.

params.label: Divider thickness
params.help: Thickness of each divider wall.

params.label: Divider height reduction
params.help: Make dividers lower than the walls so you can reach over them. 0 is full height.

params.label: Label shelf
params.help: A shelf along the back wall for a printed or written label. Its underside is angled at 45° so it prints without supports.

params.label: Label shelf depth
params.help: How far the label shelf sticks out from the back wall. 12 mm suits common label tapes.

params.label: Finger scoop
params.help: A curved ramp at the front of the floor so small parts slide out on a fingertip.

params.label: Scoop radius
params.help: Radius of the scoop curve.

params.label: Magnet holes
params.help: Four holes under each grid square for press-fit or glued disc magnets.

params.label: Magnet diameter
params.help: Hole diameter. 6.5 mm fits standard 6 x 2 mm magnets with glue clearance; try 6.1 to 6.2 for a press fit.

params.label: Magnet depth
params.help: Hole depth. 2.4 mm suits 2 mm thick magnets.

params.label: Screw holes
params.help: Four holes under each grid square for screws that fix the bin to a baseplate.

params.label: Screw hole diameter
params.help: 3 mm suits M3 screws self-tapping into the bin.

params.label: Screw hole depth
params.help: Depth from the bottom. It must stay at least 1 mm below the inside floor.

checks.message: Floor height must be at least 5.75 mm so the floor is at least 1 mm thick.
The bin is too short for this floor height: increase Height or lower the floor.
Too many dividers across: each compartment would be narrower than 8 mm.
Too many dividers front to back: each compartment would be narrower than 8 mm.

checks.expr: not label or label_w + 1.2 <= gz*7 - (2.6 - wall)*lip - floor_z + 1
checks.message: The label shelf is too deep for this bin height: make it shallower or the bin taller.
The label shelf would cover more than half of the bin's depth.

checks.expr: not scoop or scoop_r <= gz*7 - floor_z - 2
checks.message: The scoop is taller than the bin's inside: lower the scoop radius.
The scoop radius is more than half the bin's depth.
Divider height reduction is larger than the bin is deep.
Screw holes would break through the floor: make them shallower or raise the floor.

checks.expr: not (screws and magnets) or screw_d < mag_d
checks.message: Screw holes must be narrower than magnet holes when both are on.

presets.name: Heavy tools
presets.help: Thick walls for wrenches and pliers

presets.name: Desk tray
presets.help: Low, flat-topped tray for pens and cables

presets.name: Bathroom
presets.help: Cosmetics and toiletries, easy to wipe
